page_title: BRE 2-2 BOU | Brentford v Bournemouth 02/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+5' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.
90+3' 2 - 2 Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Neto with a strike into the bottom left corner. He makes it 2:2.
90+1' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
87' The referee signals a substitution. Chris Mepham (Bournemouth) is brought on as a substitute for Ryan Christie.
86' Brentford failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
84' Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Neto makes a great save.
84' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
83' That was close. David Brooks (Bournemouth) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
82' The game has come to an end for Aaron Hickey. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Michael Olakigbe (Brentford).
81' We are about to witness a substitution. Kristoffer Ajer (Brentford) is replacing Mathias Jensen.
81' Here is a change. Ben Mee is going off and Thomas Frank gives the last tactical orders to Nathan Michael Collins (Brentford).
77' 1 - 2 Goal! Marcus Tavernier feeds David Brooks (Bournemouth), who taps the ball into an empty net. He makes it 1:2.
76' Post! Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) latches on to a sweet pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which only hits the right post. What an unlucky moment for him.
76' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) wins himself just enough space inside the box to connect with the corner. His header flies towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper blocks the effort.
75' Brentford force a corner. They send men into the box.
74' Rico Henry (Brentford) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee signals a corner kick to Brentford.
71' Thomas Frank prepares a substitution. Kevin Schade is replaced by Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford).
71' That's the end of the game for Vitaly Janelt, who is replaced by Frank Onyeka (Brentford).
71' A substitution has been made. Justin Kluivert is replaced by Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth).
69' Referee Robert Madley has finally had enough of Andoni Iraola and brandishes a yellow card at him!

69' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) trips an opposition player and Robert Madley signals a foul. Bournemouth have a free kick. This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Mathias Jensen (Brentford) was quite harsh and Robert Madley didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
68' Kevin Schade (Brentford) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
65' This is a yellow card! Neto (Bournemouth) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
64' Good play from Rico Henry (Brentford) gives him some space for the shot from distance, but it's lacking accuracy and goes well wide of the left post.
63' Robert Madley blows his whistle and it's Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Bournemouth will take a free kick.
60' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Antoine Semenyo walks off the pitch to be replaced by David Brooks (Bournemouth).
60' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) expertly controls a neat clever pass inside the box, but his effort crashes against the left post! What an opportunity that was!
59' Philip Billing (Bournemouth) neatly controls a driven pass on the edge of the box, glances up and cracks a beautiful drive goalwards that sails just over the bar.
58' Close! A mistake by a defender gifts Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) a chance inside the box, but his efforts curls just around the left post.
56' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) jumps for a header from the corner kick, but fails to steer the ball into the goal as it flies high over the bar.
56' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Brentford.
55' Robert Madley has a clear sight and sees a foul from Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth). Brentford win a free kick.
51' Maximillian Aarons (Bournemouth) criticises the decision of the referee and immediately receives a yellow card.
51' The resulting corner from Philip Billing (Bournemouth) comes to nothing.
50' Philip Billing (Bournemouth) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Corner kick. Bournemouth will have an opportunity.
50' A quickly taken corner by Bournemouth.
49' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Neto, who pulls off a comfortable save!
47' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
46' The whistle blows and Robert Madley starts the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Robert Madley blows his whistle as Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack. Brentford are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.

45' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) wastes a huge opportunity. He attempts to knock a rebound low into the middle of the goal with a delicate header, but Mark Flekken stretches to keep the ball out of the net.
44' That looked a certain handball by Milos Kerkez (Bournemouth) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
43' An attempted cross from Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) is cleared.
40' The shot by Aaron Hickey (Brentford) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Neto.
39' A lofted cross from Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
39' Justin Kluivert (Bournemouth) tackles a bit over-zealously and Robert Madley blows for a foul. Brentford win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.

35' What an opportunity! Ethan Pinnock (Brentford) leaps high to meet a beautiful cross into the box from the free kick, and he plants a header from near the penalty spot which goes a whisker over the crossbar.
34' Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent. That's a free kick to Brentford.

30' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Superb finishing from Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth). Marcos Senesi plays a fantastic through ball and finds Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth), who reacts quickly to get in front of the goalkeeper and fire a close-range shot into the bottom left corner. 1:1.

29' Philip Billing sprays a wonderful pass out to Ryan Christie (Bournemouth), who cannot get enough power or direction to cause Mark Flekken problems and the goalkeeper is able to watch the ball go just wide of the right post.
28' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
26' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
26' Kevin Schade (Brentford) was too forceful with his tackle and Robert Madley interrupted the game to signal a free kick. A free kick has been awarded to Bournemouth.
25' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Yoane Wissa (Brentford) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
23' Brentford have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

23' Great first touch by Kevin Schade (Brentford) after collecting a pass deep into the box. He smashes the ball to the middle of the net, but the keeper makes a fantastic reflex save and pushes it onto the post. Brilliant goalkeeping! The referee blows his whistle, Brentford are awarded a corner kick.
21' Antoine Semenyo (Bournemouth) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.

19' Nice individual effort by Ryan Christie (Bournemouth). He gets all the way through to the keeper and hits a low drive to the middle of the goal, but Mark Flekken does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out.
19' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
16' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.

15' Aaron Hickey (Brentford) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
12' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) gets on the end of a pass and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's blocked by one of the defending players.
10' Mathias Jensen (Brentford) tries to find Kevin Schade, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball goes out of play and Bournemouth will have a goal kick.
9' Dominic Solanke (Bournemouth) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him. Brentford are awarded a free kick.
7' 1 - 0 Mathias Jensen (Brentford) can showcase his brilliant free kick ability, particularly from a distance like this. He hits the ball perfectly and it ends up inside the left post.
7' Neto (Bournemouth) is penalised after knocking an opponent down. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Brentford.
6' Ben Mee (Brentford) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.

5' Maximillian Aarons (Bournemouth) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Robert Madley no option but to blow his whistle. Brentford have a free kick.

5' Philip Billing (Bournemouth) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Brentford.
3' Kevin Schade (Brentford) commits a foul and Robert Madley immediately signals a free kick. There is a free kick near the sideline to Bournemouth.
2' A pass from Ryan Christie (Bournemouth) is intercepted by Mark Flekken and the move breaks down.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Brentford will have the kick-off.
Robert Madley got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
